Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial analysis of the WebSurfer's results. Although the WebSurfer correctly retrieved search results from Wikipedia stating that "Robert Clark Seger" is "more commonly referred to by his stage name– Robert Seger," the Planner incorrectly concluded that his stage name is "Robert Seger." In reality, Robert C. Seger's famous stage name is simply "Bob Seger." The search results explicitly state "Bob Seger" in the visible text snippets (e.g., "Bob Seger Lyrics...", "bobseger.com"), but the Planner overlooked this and failed to distinguish between the formal shortened name "Robert" and the actual stage name "Bob." This led to the wrong final answer.
